problem:
The random variable $X$ has the following probability distribution.

| $x$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${f}_{X}(x)$ | $0.25$ | $0.55$ | $0.2$ |

Let $Y=5-{X}^{3}.$ The distribution of $Y$ is given below.

| $y$ | $4$ | $5$ | $a$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${f}_{Y}(y)$ | $c$ | $b$ | $0.25$ |

What is the value of $a+c?$
